title: Cast a Spell
subtitle: Use a spell with a 1-bonus-action cast time
description: Cast a spell that has a casting time of 1 Bonus Action. This is typically a swift spell.

bullets.content: Crucial Rule: On a turn, you can expend only one spell slot to cast a spell. You can't, for example, cast a spell with a spell slot as your action and another one using your bonus action on the same turn.

title: Offhand Attack
subtitle: Part of Two-Weapon Fighting
description: If you take the Attack action and attack with a Light weapon, you can use a Bonus Action to make one attack with a different Light weapon.

bullets.content: The following rules apply to this bonus action attack:

items: This is only usable if you take the Attack action and attack with a light weapon.
You don't add your ability modifier to the damage of the bonus attack, unless that modifier is negative.

bullets.content: This is a common feature of dual-wielding fighting styles.

title: Use Class Feature
subtitle: Activate a feature requiring a bonus action
description: Many class and racial features allow you to take a Bonus Action to activate a special ability.
reference: See class page for more information.

bullets.content: You can take a bonus action only when a special ability, spell, or other feature of the game states that you can do something as a bonus action.
